hero_text: Tools born in the field in West Africa, to design, assess and monitor energy systems. Try them, buy them, and find everything in your account.

how_intro: One account for all KYA-Energy Group software.

how_buy_text: Choose the edition, the duration and the number of seats. Pay with Mobile Money or card.
how_manage_text: Licences, seats, downloads, purchase invoices and support requests, in your account.
kya_text: An energy engineering and research company that builds its software from its own installations. What we sell here, we use first.
faq_account_q: Does one account work for all software?
faq_account_a: Yes. The same account gives access to trials, purchases and downloads for every product on KYA-EnergyMarket.
faq_pay_a: With Mobile Money or a bank card, through Semoa. Institutions can request a quote and pay by bank transfer.
faq_invoice_q: When will I get my invoice?
faq_invoice_a: Right after payment: the purchase invoice is emailed to you and stays in your account, under Purchase invoices.
faq_seats_q: Can I use a licence on several computers?
faq_seats_a: A licence has a number of seats. Buy several and assign them to your colleagues from your account.
